floorplan.basis: Positive full replacement logic allowance plus prior routed body; geometric area estimate excludes CTS/PG and route overhead.

latency_calendar.basis: Existing exact bench E1-E5, granted(), good_case() and warm rearm assertions; conditional immediate acceptance/cleanup, excluding external work and stalls.
